stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a generative language model.
The tags confirm its association with major AI frameworks like transformers and the Llama family.

stories.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model, has emerged as a significant competitor to top US AI systems.
The model is noted for allegedly achieving superior performance at a substantially lower cost.
This development intensifies the ongoing technological and competitive rivalry between Chinese and US AI sectors.

stories.title: Amazon’s trying to launch a global satellite cellphone network in 2028
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Amazon is planning to launch a global satellite cellphone network using a new Leo constellation.
The service aims to provide direct-to-device connectivity for voice, messaging, data, and emergency services.
Deployment is targeted for 2028, pending FCC approval and partnerships with mobile network operators.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML frameworks like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under key ML/AI domains such as transformers, llama, and text-generation.
This indicates ongoing community interest and performance tracking for Meta's latest LLM releases.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88 million.
The funding round involved prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama serves a large developer community, boasting 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance using Gemma 4 sees up to 90% speed improvement on the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher quality outputs, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these AI agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, enhancing local AI capabilities on Macs.
The feature is currently available in preview, signaling a push toward optimized local ML deployment.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring all processing runs entirely on the user's device.
The core value proposition is providing private, on-device AI capabilities for coding assistance.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft has announced new AI security tools.
The company claims these tools offer superior performance compared to competitors.
A key selling point is that Microsoft asserts its tools are more cost-effective than rivals.

stories.title: 5th Circuit blocks Texas law requiring websites to filter "harmful" speech
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The 5th Circuit Court blocked a Texas law mandating websites filter 'harmful' speech.
The ruling found that attempts to regulate content filtering are preempted by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act.
The court distinguished between age verification (which is permissible) and content moderation/filtering (which is restricted).

stories.title: Verizon touts $1B dark fiber deal for Google data centers as first of many
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Verizon secured a $1 billion dark fiber deal with Google for data center infrastructure.
The deal signals a growing trend of telecom providers leveraging dark fiber for hyperscale cloud needs.
The industry anticipates significant future revenue growth driven by AI demand for high-capacity data center connectivity.

stories.title: ChatGPT starts blocking direct requests to copy an author's style
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: ChatGPT is implementing new restrictions against direct requests to replicate an author's specific writing style.
This shift suggests a move by AI developers to address potential legal and ethical concerns regarding style mimicry.
The ability to capture 'broad qualities' of a writer raises significant questions about intellectual property and authorship in the AI era.

stories.title: Opaque Epistemic Mediation: How LLM Deployment Configurations Shape the Validation of Pseudo-Science
stories.author: Joaquim Pina
bullet_points: Investigates the lack of stability and transparency in how major LLMs (Claude, Grok, GPT, Gemini) validate contested scientific claims.
Tests LLM responses to ethnonationalist pseudo-science across four major models and four temporal snapshots.
Highlights the impact of deployment configurations (e.g., Grok's Fast versions) on the models' output regarding sensitive topics.

stories.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces CausalForge, a new agentic framework designed to automate theoretical research in causal inference.
Addresses the critical flaw in current LLM-based research loops: the empirical unreliability of LLM reviewers.
Grounds the framework in the Lean proof system to ensure formally grounded and self-improving research capabilities.

stories.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces CausalForge, a new agentic framework designed to automate theoretical research in causal inference.
Addresses the critical weakness of current LLM-based reviewers, which are empirically unreliable at detecting fabricated research.
Grounds the automated research process in the Lean proof methodology to ensure formal correctness and self-improvement.

stories.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
stories.author: Guanjun Jiang
bullet_points: The research addresses a core dilemma in LLM self-evolution: balancing broad task diversity with reliable feedback.
Existing methods are limited, either being too narrow (environment-bound) or too unreliable (open-ended self-generation).
The paper proposes using 'agent skills' as a mechanism to push LLM capabilities through interaction-driven, self-evolving training.

stories.title: Opaque Epistemic Mediation: How LLM Deployment Configurations Shape the Validation of Pseudo-Science
stories.author: Joaquim Pina
bullet_points: Investigates the non-transparent and unstable ways major LLMs (Claude, Grok, GPT, Gemini) evaluate contested scientific claims.
The study specifically tests LLM responses against ethnonationalist pseudo-science across different temporal snapshots.
Highlights the impact of LLM deployment configurations (e.g., API vs. web interface, specific model versions like Grok's Fast) on output bias.

stories.title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents
stories.author: Kai Zheng
bullet_points: Introduces DBA-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based database operations agents with production-level fidelity.
Highlights critical gaps in current LLM evaluation, including lack of live-environment fidelity and complex observation spaces.
Stresses the need to account for solution-space openness, where multiple operational trade-offs exist for remediation.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware platforms.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The new feature set includes the capability for web search functionality in Claude Code.
This integration enhances the complexity and capability of AI agents running through Ollama.

stories.title: X Money is launching in the US starting today
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: X Money, a payment platform, is launching in the US as part of X's 'everything app' strategy.
The service includes a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payment functionality, comparable to Venmo.
Users will have access to a customizable metal Visa card and Apple Wallet integration.

stories.title: Experts warn current Starship heat shield tech is a "dead end" for rapid reuse
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Current Starship heat shield technology is being flagged by experts as potentially insufficient for rapid reuse.
The warning highlights a long-term gap in NASA's investment in thermal protection research.
The issue points to a critical engineering challenge for achieving fully reusable heavy-lift launch systems.

stories.title: SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction
stories.author: Jiwen Lu
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of extending 3D reconstruction to 4D dynamic understanding using Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs).
Existing motion perception methods often treat motion as independent point-wise displacements, failing to capture physical structure.
The proposed SM4RT method focuses on learning structured motion geometry, acknowledging that real-world objects adhere to rigid-body kinematics.

stories.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers
stories.author: Salvatore Venticinque
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical need for Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) in high-stakes environments.
Building trust in AI is identified as essential for integrating AI into critical sectors like aviation and healthcare.
The research focuses on advancing human-AI collaboration through increased AI system transparency.

stories.title: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
stories.author: Baran Nama
bullet_points: Introduces the concept of 'The Regression Tax,' highlighting that adding skills to LLM agents can sometimes degrade performance.
The research moves beyond simple task success metrics by quantifying both improvements and performance regressions.
The study validates these findings across extensive testing (6,000 runs) using multiple office automation benchmarks and model stacks.

stories.title: \k{appa}-LoRA: Condition Numbers Reveal Which LoRA Matrices Worth Updating
stories.author: Yaqi Xie
bullet_points: The paper addresses the computational inefficiency of standard LoRA fine-tuning, which updates all low-rank matrices uniformly.
It introduces $\kappa$-LoRA, a method that uses condition numbers to selectively determine which LoRA matrices require updating.
This selective updating aims to reduce computational costs, making fine-tuning more feasible for large models and resource-constrained edge devices.

stories.title: MineValiCoder: Reliable Code Generation with Test Case Quality Mining and Bipartite Graph-Based Mutual Validation
stories.author: Bo Li
bullet_points: Introduces MineValiCoder, a new method to improve LLM-based Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Addresses the limitation of current LLM code generation systems that rely heavily on human-crafted test cases.
Mitigates issues arising from LLM stochasticity, specifically faulty or mixed-quality generated tests.

stories.title: Learning to Prepare Molecular Ground States with Transformer Models
stories.author: Enrico Rinaldi
bullet_points: The research addresses the computational bottleneck in quantum state preparation for large molecules, a critical step in quantum chemistry.
A new generative AI framework, ADAPT-GQE, is introduced to learn the synthesis of ground-state preparation circuits.
This work aims to overcome the limitations of iterative algorithms like ADAPT-VQE for practical applications in materials science and pharmaceuticals.

stories.title: TRACE-ROUTER: Task-Consistent and Adaptive Online Routing for Agentic AI
stories.author: Tushar Krishna
bullet_points: Introduces TRACE-ROUTER, a new routing mechanism designed for agentic AI workflows.
Addresses the limitation of existing routers that make independent, per-call decisions, which fails in long-horizon tasks.
Aims to enable task-consistent and adaptive routing by linking routing decisions to delayed, task-level outcomes.

stories.title: PinEqualizer: Full Funnel Content Exploration and Debiasing System at Pinterest
stories.author: Zhihua Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces PinEqualizer, a system designed to solve the content cold-start problem in large-scale search and recommender systems.
The solution operates across the entire multi-stage content funnel, applicable to both search and recommendation surfaces.
It effectively reduces content bias favoring existing popular items, leading to more accurate predictions across different content types.

stories.title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
stories.author: Zhandong Liu
bullet_points: Introduces 'bag-of-waves,' an interpretable framework for analyzing Electroencephalography (EEG) data.
Addresses limitations of traditional EEG analysis (predefined features bias) and deep learning (lack of interpretability, data hunger).
Aims to learn a small dictionary of recurring EEG waveforms, making analysis effective even in low-data regimes.

stories.title: A Factorial Study of Synthetic Data Generation for Low-Resource Machine Translation using Grammar Books
stories.author: Rico Sennrich
bullet_points: Addresses the critical problem of low-resource machine translation for endangered languages lacking parallel data.
Proposes a novel pipeline using LLMs to extract linguistic knowledge (rules, examples, lexicons) from existing grammar books.
Generates synthetic parallel corpora for model fine-tuning, contrasting with prior methods that used grammar content during inference.

stories.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
stories.author: Honggang Qi
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of consolidating diverse, open-weight language models from different families.
It introduces Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM) to enable cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD).
BPM solves issues in existing methods where teacher probability mass is lost or incorrectly assigned during distillation.

stories.title: Biomedical Machine Translation for Low-Resource Arabic-Script Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and LoRA Adapter Merging
stories.author: Lifeng Han
bullet_points: Addresses the critical problem of low-resource biomedical Machine Translation (NMT) for Arabic-script languages.
Employs cross-lingual transfer, using Arabic and Persian as high-resource pivots to aid four low-resource targets (Dari, Pashto, Sorani Kurdish, Urdu).
Utilizes LoRA adapter merging for efficient fine-tuning, demonstrating a practical approach to resource-constrained NLP tasks.

stories.title: Why Large Language Models and Humans Converge and Diverge in Evaluating Creativity
stories.author: Yingyue Luna Luan
bullet_points: The study investigates the alignment between Large Language Model (LLM) evaluations of creativity and human judgments.
Evidence regarding the convergence or divergence of LLM and human creativity assessments is currently mixed.
The research analyzed six widely used LLMs across three studies to identify the underlying standards of LLM creativity evaluation.

stories.title: From Isolated Tasks to Structured Capabilities: A Multilayer Taxonomy for Large Language Models
stories.author: Yanghua Xiao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the fragmentation in LLM evaluation, which currently focuses on isolated tasks rather than underlying capabilities.
It introduces a novel, multi-layer taxonomy comprising 14 capability domains and 91 subskills.
This taxonomy is structured across Primitive, Constructed, and Integrative layers, guided by human cognitive science principles.

stories.title: Launch HN: Rise Reforming (YC S26) – Turning Waste Gases into Valuable Chemicals
stories.author: george_rose25
bullet_points: Rise Reforming is developing a process to convert waste gases (biogas from landfills, farms, wastewater plants) into valuable chemicals.
Their technology is modular, allowing for on-site deployment and operation.
The company acts as a chemical project developer, bridging biogas producers and chemical end-users.

stories.title: Building AI Agents with the TypeScript Agent Development Kit (ADK)
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: Introduces the TypeScript Agent Development Kit (ADK) for building AI agents.
Leverages Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash model for agent functionality.
Provides a deployment path using Cloud Run for practical application.

stories.title: AgentGuard 1.1: An Open-Source Firewall for Inter-Agent AI Messages
stories.author: nizba06
bullet_points: Introduction of AgentGuard 1.1, an open-source firewall specifically designed for inter-agent AI communications.
The article addresses a security concern in AI agents beyond model hallucination, focusing on message integrity.
The tool targets the growing complexity and potential risks associated with multi-agent AI systems.
